transcript:
SIMULATED ROLE-PLAY TRANSCRIPT — not a recorded client meeting.
Consultant: What would a successful first release include?
Client: A membership website with member email notifications, member import from CSV, and an admin dashboard.
Consultant: Are there integrations?
Client: We also want a custom integration with Salesforce.
Client: Our budget is limited and we are aiming for six weeks.
Consultant: I will treat these as candidate requirements and verify platform feasibility before any proposal.

SIMULATED ROLE-PLAY TRANSCRIPT — not a recorded client meeting.
Consultant: Please describe the directory experience.
Client: We need a course directory with instructor profiles and a contact form.
Consultant: How will you communicate updates?
Client: Weekly email updates to enrolled learners.
Client: We would also like student progress reports exported to CSV.
Consultant: I will identify what is standard configuration and what needs discovery.

SIMULATED ROLE-PLAY TRANSCRIPT — not a recorded client meeting.
Consultant: What must visitors be able to find?
Client: Agent profiles, property listings, and a search page.
Consultant: Does information need to connect elsewhere?
Client: Yes, a custom connection to our existing CRM.
Client: We hope to launch in four weeks and need a preliminary estimate.
Consultant: The estimate will be a planning range pending feasibility, access, and acceptance criteria.

SIMULATED ROLE-PLAY FOLLOW-UP — not a recorded client meeting.
Consultant: We are reviewing changes against the first simulated discussion.
Client: Remove Salesforce integration from the initial launch. Keep member CSV import and the admin dashboard.
Client: Add SMS notifications instead of email notifications. The six-week target remains.
Consultant: I will mark this as a scope change requiring feasibility, consent/provider review, and re-estimation before approval.
